description: R39/R40/A52 performance: a mirror of tasks/adaptive-memory/eval/perf/performance.json (written by eval/perf/scripts/analyze.py) plus the verified verdicts of eval/perf/REPORT.md, the run-level recomputation and the pre-perf measurements

verified_verdicts.source: tasks/adaptive-memory/eval/perf/REPORT.md (verdicts rewritten after an independent read-only verification that recomputed every pooled quantile, overhead and CI from eval/perf/raw/ with a different bootstrap seed)
verified_verdicts.supersedes: the `criteria` block below as written by analyze.py: its 'holds' flags are point-estimate readings, and its 'holds_with_ci' flags rest on the analysis plan's cluster bootstrap, which the verification found anti-conservative. eval/perf/REPORT.md's closing 'What holds' list still carries that earlier wording; its criteria table and verification paragraph carry the verified verdicts
verified_verdicts.why: the cluster bootstrap resamples within runs and ignores between-run variance; in an A/A check (one arm's 4 runs split into two pseudo-arms, 60 comparisons) its 95% CI excluded 0 in 62% of p95 cases against a nominal 5% (eval/perf/REPORT.md; the A/A check was not re-run here). Implausible 'significant' results follow from it (D faster than B at noobs conc p95; B vs A conc p95 +8.8% [+1.0, +19.3])

secondary_inprocess_phase_p95_per_round.method: harness percentile of the context_admission phase per run (16 warm-ups discarded by the driver); the pooled p95 and its within-run bootstrap CI are in admission_inprocess

admission_det_p95_le_150ms.observe_recall_p95_overhead_c8: E+observe vs E-ext concurrent recall p95: pooled point estimate +22.1% (+158 ms), not resolved at run level: t95 [-9.0, +40.4], per round +36.2%, -0.7%, +9.9%, +17.4%; the admission phase p95 itself (273.9 ms pooled) is stable across rounds
admission_det_p95_le_150ms.jev_and_hybrid_paths: one TypeSafe call per recall: phase p50 / p95 344.9 / 432.5 ms (hybrid, F strict) and 347.7 / 432.1 ms (jev, E-jev filter); not under the 150 ms item, which names the deterministic path

verified_verdicts.p95_is_gc_dominated: about 12% of sequential recalls in every arm, A included, carry an extra ~190 ms; the sequential p95 (about 255-270 ms everywhere) measures that stall, not the per-recall work (gc_probe below: 47 gen-2 collections over 100 ms in a window the length of the sequential phase vs 47 sequential recalls over 150 ms, a count match, not a per-sample alignment)
verified_verdicts.median_cost: noobs sequential p50: D +9.1% (+6.6 ms), E +8.6% (+6.3 ms); concurrent p50 +11.4% / +14.2%
verified_verdicts.undeclared_deviation: DESIGN.md 11.4's gate (median of >= 5 runs at --scale large) was replaced by 4 pooled medium rounds; under the median-of-per-run-p95 form, noobs E conc is +10.7% and obs D seq +6.2%, both over their bars (run_level_recomputation)
verified_verdicts.machine: Apple M1 Pro, 10 cores; runs waited while the 1-minute load was > 8 (at most 10 min); background load about 3-4 cores; 3 noobs round-4 runs started above the ceiling after the maximum wait; not an idle machine

run_level_recomputation.method: per round r: overhead_r = p_arm_r / p_ref_r - 1; mean +/- t(0.975, 3) * sd / sqrt(4); median_of_run_p95 = median_r p95_arm_r / median_r p95_ref_r - 1. Recomputed here from the per-round quantiles in performance.json; it reproduces the run-level t95 intervals quoted in eval/perf/REPORT.md

recall_design.scale: perf-test medium recall bank: 1000 facts, the suite's populate (mock LLM, async retain via in-process worker), RRF reranker stand-in, budget HIGH, max_tokens 4096, trace on
recall_design.order: odd rounds in listed order, even rounds reversed (ABBA-style drift cancellation)
recall_design.per_run: 16 warm-up recalls discarded, then 400 sequential (c=1) and 200 concurrent (c=8, the suite's medium concurrency) recalls cycling the suite's 8 queries
recall_design.planner_state: VACUUM ANALYZE before populate, ANALYZE after populate/consolidation (same for every arm)

statistics.ci: 95% percentile bootstrap, 10000 replicates, arms resampled independently; resampling unit = cluster of 8 recalls (one query cycle for sequential, one gathered batch for concurrent), stratified by round
statistics.overhead: p95_X / p95_ref - 1 (also p50, p99, mean); refs: D,E,C vs B; B vs A; E+admission arms vs E-ext

criteria.lifecycle: E vs B pooled p95 overhead < 10%
criteria.rank: D vs B pooled p95 overhead < 5%
criteria.evaluation: judged separately for sequential and concurrent shapes and for noobs and obs scenarios; reported as 'holds' only where the point estimate is below the bar, and 'holds with CI' where the upper 95% bound is also below it; the decision-rule verdict uses the noobs scenario (the perf-test recall suite) on both shapes, obs is reported alongside
criteria.admission: deterministic-path context_admission phase p95 <= 150 ms over >= 200 recalls; measured on context_bench dev queries via the HTTP server (primary, real metadata/scope) and in-process on the perf bank (secondary)

provenance.reranker: in-process suites: the harness's RRF stand-in (_RRFReranker); context_bench: local cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 on CPU
provenance.llm: mock provider (perf harness) / provider none (context_bench); Jev = TypeSafe decision model for the hybrid/jev admission scorers only; no Anthropic calls

sensitivity_exploratory.note: written after the pooled results were seen; rounds_1_3 drops round 4 (load-ceiling breaches, XProtect), rounds_2_4 drops round 1 (B slow in every quantile)

fk_bulk_delete_cost_P1.source: tasks/adaptive-memory/PLAN.md (P6 bullet) and STATE.md P1 entry
